title: DoT data obtained by The Hindu under RTI (reported 9 Nov 2026): 11,372 Indian villages have no 4G, down from 45,180 in 2022 (about 75%); Odisha has the most (1,789), then Arunachal Pradesh (1,518); about 40 lakh people live in villages without 4G, around 46% in ST-majority villages; the fall beats BSNL's 24,680-village saturation target; 26,000 more tower sites sanctioned; Telecom Minister Scindia had targeted every village by June 2026 (the count's date is not given)
sources: https://trai.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-10/PR_No127of2026.pdf (TRAI Yearly Performance Indicators 2025-26, 5 Oct 2026: 1,092.79 million internet subscribers, 1,026.75 million wireless data subscribers at end-March 2026; supports 'Mobile data is how most Indians get online' with The Hindu)
